profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a public company headquartered in Tel Aviv that trades under the ticker WIX. Its own site presents it as a website builder: the company describes a free, easy-to-use builder that offers 2,000+ templates, built-in AI tools and a custom domain, with templates that can be customized manually or with AI. The site also says users can sell products, services and memberships from one dashboard with zero plugins, and that businesses can keep growing with specialized AI agents.

The company's AI position, as described on its own site, rests on AI tools built into the website builder and on AI agents aimed at business growth. No lawsuits, no MCP servers and no separately tracked products are recorded for the company. Its registration details list CIK 0001576789 and its website as wix.com.
